# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.2 Shared Normative Module: Requirements

Module identity: `SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENTS v0.1/r0.2`

Status: implementation-blind Stage B draft authority; content-bound by
`SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_MODULE_BINDING v0.1/r0.2`; not owner-accepted or frozen.

Normative terms: `shall` is required, `shall not` is prohibited, `may` is
permitted only within the stated boundary, and `unavailable` is a typed
scientific state rather than a numerical sentinel.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-001` NOI-GEN, NOI-UNC, and NOI-STD shall remain separate
scientific operations. No operation shall automatically realize, authorize,
or mutate another.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-002` The selected ordinary route shall remain
`NOI-GEN/PTC-TO-FROZEN-MAP-CONDITIONAL-SIGN@1`, with exact retained PTC
occurrences as earliest immutable parent and the exact PTC-to-MAP boundary as
insertion point. Its output shall be an NOI realization map, not ordinary MAP
science.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-003` Every GEN method shall classify consequential adjacent state
as fixed, rerun/relearned, not applicable, or unavailable. Different fixed/
relearned classes or replay graphs shall not share an ensemble.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-004` The ordinary coherence unit shall be one stable realized
detector/channel in one exact observation. Its modifier shall apply to every
admitted occurrence for that detector in that observation and shall be ordered
by canonical scientific identity rather than execution order.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-005` Network-stratified balance shall use exact frozen positive
pre-normalization coefficient mass `beta_d` from `SCI-NOI-EQ-003`. No network,
array, or observation shall balance another, and `beta_d` shall not be promoted
to precision, uncertainty weight, exposure, validity, or a MAP coefficient.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-006` Base product scope shall remain unavailable pending
`SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-SCOPE-01`. The r0.2 candidate is one observation-level
ensemble per exact observation and array, with no cross-observation ensemble
or randomized coadd. A multi-observation/coadd GEN route shall require a
separate method, parent, assignment law, response, coefficient, and atomicity
contract.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-007` Every ordinary member shall satisfy `SCI-NOI-EQ-005`. The
modifier shall act only on `Z_i^PTC`, exactly once. Every coefficient,
membership, denominator, WCS, projection, support, `coverage_cut`, response
rule, and MAP-local gate shall remain frozen.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-008` Inline and materialized sign application shall be equivalent
only when they realize the identical equation, occurrence membership,
modifier, frozen operator, and output domain. The all-`+1` operation shall
retain the distinct ordinary MAP identity in `SCI-NOI-EQ-006`.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-009` The fixed-state signal/response relation shall satisfy
`SCI-NOI-EQ-007`. A required response companion shall receive identical
membership and the identical modifier exactly once. Missing response shall be
typed unavailable and shall not create a hidden signal subset.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-010` Products shall distinguish the complete coherence
population, positive-mass active population, zero-mass detectors, zero-total-
mass strata, singleton active strata, and unavailable/ambiguous network
membership. No imbalance ratio shall be evaluated with a zero denominator.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-011` Zero-mass, zero-total, singleton, ambiguous-membership, and
active-sign-matrix treatment shall remain unavailable pending acceptance of
the complete finite-design disposition. The r0.1 singleton failure prediction
shall not be retained as binding owner-approved science.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-012` Exact ODQ-102D finite-design mechanics shall remain
unavailable until the owner answers `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-102D-01` for the complete
candidate as one indivisible disposition. Reviewer recommendations and author
proposals shall not become base-v0.1 defaults.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-013` Before candidate or member output is inspected, an accepted
design plan shall preregister every tolerance, requested count, retry cap,
generator/version, seed/key bytes, namespace, persistence mode, ordering, and
target-law identity. Any post-inspection change shall create a new plan and
generation.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-014` If the recommended bounded first-accepted rejection design
is owner-approved, finite retry shall affect design-resolution probability but,
conditional on successful resolution, shall not change the uniform law over
the admissible sign vectors. This conditional result shall not imply approval
of the design.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-015` Complement-related assignments shall remain distinct; no
complement pair shall be forced to occur. Exact duplicates, complement orbits,
replacement rules, and draw weights shall remain separately declared under an
accepted design.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-016` Products shall report requested, resolved, completed,
admitted, signed-vector-unique, and complement-orbit-unique counts separately.
They shall report `r_sign`, `r_map`, and use-specific effective Monte Carlo
information separately; none shall substitute for another.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-017` The product class `source-bearing conditional randomization
ensemble` shall carry the narrow objective and exclusions in D-005. Complete
complement symmetry shall establish zero target-law mean only; it shall not
remove source or structured residual terms from members, second moments, or
tails.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-018` Every admitted assignment shall complete through the exact
declared frozen operator. Any incomplete, failed, or unavailable admitted
member shall fail the ensemble for initial UNC. Survivors and partial
accumulators shall have diagnostic identity only.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-019` An idempotent execution retry may retain scientific member,
assignment, parent, operator, and generation identity only when deterministic
work is identical and a new execution/evidence attempt identity is recorded.
A changed assignment or scientific state shall be a replacement with new
scientific identity.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-020` Each ODQ-109 persistence plan shall select persisted,
compact-regeneration, streaming-sufficient-statistic, or an explicitly
separate composite plan. It shall declare exact reconstruction, numerical
regeneration, retained sufficiency, unavailable later questions, requested/
effective/resolved/applied/realized lifecycle, failure, and completion. No
default or silent fallback is permitted.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-021` An externally owned deterministic transform shall be used
only under exact owner authority and parity for purpose, algorithm, state,
parameters, order, domain, support/edge/missing-data behavior, normalization,
units, response, validity, lifecycle, and failure. NOI shall not choose, tune,
substitute, relocate, simplify, or silently omit it.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-022` Wiener or FRUIT learning, selection, continuation, update,
or per-member replay shall create every applicable new immutable owner,
science-product, GEN, and UNC generation. Fixed and relearned members shall not
mix. All base-v0.1 numerical transformed routes remain unavailable pending
their exact owner boundaries.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-023` Every UNC method shall bind exact target law, admitted GEN
generation/membership, center, estimator, weights, dependence/missingness,
domain, WCS/support/response/unit, representation, both applicable ranks,
regularization, calibration/omissions, estimator uncertainty, lifecycle,
claim, and named use.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-024` Initial UNC shall consume only an exact all-members-
successful ensemble admitted by the named member and ensemble profiles.
Rejected candidates, failed ensembles, survivors, pairwise subsets, mixed
methods, failed persistence, and partial streaming state shall not be admitted.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-025` Initial UNC shall compute `SCI-NOI-EQ-009` on one exact
common all-member domain. Its target shall be the conditional detector-sign
law with zero target mean from complement symmetry. It shall not subtract the
finite ensemble mean or infer a `B` or `B-1` correction.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-026` `Vhat_cond` shall have squared signal units and shall be
labeled conditional detector-sign-randomization marginal variance/second
moment for the fixed declared target only. It shall not be repeated physical-
noise variance, total MAP uncertainty, covariance completeness, precision, or
significance. Source and deterministic residual imprint shall remain explicit.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-027` Estimator uncertainty for `Vhat_cond` shall be numerical and
explicit or typed unavailable. Member count, sign uniqueness, complement-orbit
uniqueness, `r_sign`, `r_map`, and effective Monte Carlo information shall not
be conflated with that uncertainty.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-028` Retained ensemble, marginal variance, fixed projection,
structured/full covariance, reciprocal, precision, consumer weight, and
unavailable representations shall remain separately versioned roles. Missing
covariance shall be unknown/unavailable rather than zero or independence.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-029` The r0.2 reciprocal successor shall remain unavailable
pending `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-107-NAME-01` and an immutable profile/source
successor. If accepted, it shall use `SCI-NOI-EQ-010` only on the exact finite
strictly positive parent domain and shall not be inverse variance, precision,
validity, support, exposure, a consumer weight, or a PTC/MAP coefficient.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-030` The initial STD method shall use `m_MAP`, `sigma_cond`, and
`zeta_cond` exactly as `SCI-NOI-EQ-011` and `SCI-NOI-EQ-012` on the compatible
finite-positive intersection. It shall not interpolate, extend, substitute,
regularize, or create an implicit reciprocal route. JINC remains separate and
unavailable.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-031` `zeta_cond` shall have unit exactly `1`, explicit numerator/
scale dependence, and the sole claim: "MAP signal standardized by the stated
conditional detector-sign-randomization second-moment scale." No Gaussian,
Student, pivotal, z, N-sigma, probability, detection, false-alarm,
completeness, purity, or catalog claim shall follow.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-032` Every NOI admission evaluation shall retain separately named
request, applicability, eligibility, and realization fields. Only the exact
positive conjunction shall project to one exact action. A generic flag or
another-use result shall have no universal veto, rescue, or propagation.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-033` Generation-input admission shall permit only one exact
candidate occurrence for the selected GEN method. Assignment, MAP
application, completion, ensemble completion, and UNC admission shall remain
separate.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-034` Uncertainty-member admission shall consume but not redefine
GEN completion, failure, duplicate/equivalence, support, source-imprint, QC,
persistence, lifecycle, cause, and provenance facts. It shall admit only one
candidate member for one named UNC method.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-035` Uncertainty-ensemble admission shall permit only one exact
complete all-members-successful ensemble for one exact estimator/domain. It
shall not realize the estimator or create another covariance/consumer use.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-036` Standardization admission shall permit only the exact
initial MAP numerator/scale join and claim. Because r0.2 notation changes the
registered Stage A action bytes, r0.2 evaluation shall remain unavailable
until an immutable profile/Registry successor is approved and bound.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-037` Missing, conflicting, incomplete, unsupported, invalid, or
failed required facts shall yield their typed state. No undocumented zero,
NaN, infinity, empty object, filename, equal shape, approximate WCS, or hidden
default shall establish success.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-038` PTC, MAP, JINC, transform, Wiener, FRUIT, and prior NOI
parents shall remain immutable. Every later result shall be a new versioned
companion with exact parent, method, generation, dependence, and lifecycle.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-039` No NOI assignment, uncertainty, reciprocal, precision,
scale, or weight shall become validity, support, exposure, or a PTC/MAP
analysis, gridding, or coadd coefficient without separately approved successor
authority.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-040` The four owner-approved Stage A profiles and exact SCI-VAL
successors shall remain immutable. r0.2 shall report their exact bindings and
shall not infer compatibility for changed r0.2 bytes.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-041` The rationale and ECS shall import or content-bind the exact
six shared normative modules. They shall not independently author equations,
requirements, or predictions. Any module byte change shall require a new
binding digest and document generation.

`SCI-NOI-REQ-042` This draft shall establish no implementation conformity,
numerical validation, calibration, physical-noise validity, covariance
completeness, Gaussian significance, achieved performance, readiness, freeze,
production suitability, or production authorization. Every unresolved route
shall remain unavailable.
